subject: Decision: fixed budget tiers for v1, LRB on 5/12
body:
Team,

Decisions ahead of the 5/12 Launch Review Board slot:

1. Serving: v1 uses three fixed step-budget tiers (fast/balanced/max-quality). Zeke and I agreed dynamic batching is the right long-term answer but not a v1 dependency; Shipyard will scope it for Q3.
2. Compression pilot ships as an internal tool first - the 0.21 bits/dim win plus single-example capability is the headline for the review.
3. The de-dup pipeline graduates with us: Halima will present it as reusable infrastructure in the appendix, since honestly it's half the reason our numbers are trustworthy.

Efe/Saoirse - dry run of the demo Friday. Halima/Tereza - corpus lineage doc to Kofi for a lightweight privacy check, he confirmed the 2-3 week SLA doesn't block an internal-only launch.

Zofia
